text: A bill left open is money we haven't collected, and a family who may be surprised later. If a bill is still open at six p.m., whoever put the first charge on it gets a task.
Casey charged Biscuit's exam yesterday, and the bill is still open.
The one thing to remember: use the task's own buttons, so every reach-out is logged on the task.
Open invoice, Text to Pay, Text owner and Email owner are all right here.
Text to Pay writes a text with a pay link for exactly what's owed.
When you send it, it's logged on the task. Close it for now.
Called and got voicemail? Write it down.
Tick this to file the note on Tom's client record too.
Every reach-out stacks up here, so the next person knows what's been tried.
Tom calls back and asks us to use the card on file. Click Open invoice.
The bill is paid. Now back to Tasks.
The task is already gone. Paying the bill closes it, so there's nothing to mark done.

The most common mistakes: texting or calling from your own phone, so nothing is logged, and marking the task done before the bill is paid, which brings it back. Remember: use the task's own buttons, so every reach-out is logged on the task.
